plainText:
Chiko (Japanese: チコ Chico) is a Pokémon in Magical Pokémon Journey. Chiko is friends with .

==History==
When Chiko was first introduced, she fell in love with Pistachio and caused a fight and a competition with Bulbasaur. However, after she saw Pistachio trying to cheer up Bulbasaur when she lost, she apologized and the two Pokémon became close friends. She often talks in the third person.

Later, she develops a crush on .

==Personality and characteristics==
Chiko at times can be self-centered and bossy.
